Check 1 (warning): Fork Length — High NA Rate

Flag stream/site/run_years where >95% of records have no fork length recorded and total records exceed 50. Indicates a season where measurements were not taken.

Code 
fl_na_all <- rst_catch |>
  filter(!is.na(date)) |>
  mutate(run_year = as_run_year(date)) |>
  group_by(stream, site, run_year) |>
  summarise(
    n_records    = n(),
    n_na_fl      = sum(is.na(fork_length)),
    pct_na_fl    = round(mean(is.na(fork_length)) * 100, 1),
    .groups      = "drop"
  )

fl_na_check <- fl_na_all |>
  filter(pct_na_fl > 95, n_records > 50)

new_fl_na <- log_issues(
  fl_na_check |>
    mutate(
      data_type   = "rst",
      issue_type  = "high_na_rate",
      field       = "fork_length",
      severity    = "moderate",
      alert_level = "warning",
      description = glue("{n_na_fl} of {n_records} records ({pct_na_fl}%) have no fork length in run year {run_year} at {site} ({stream})")
    )
)

Check 2 (warning): Fork Length — Implausible Values

Flag records where fork_length < 20mm or fork_length > 200mm. These are biologically implausible for juvenile chinook at an RST.

Code 
fl_impl_all <- rst_catch |>
  filter(!is.na(fork_length), fork_length > 0) |>
  mutate(run_year = as_run_year(date)) |>
  mutate(implausible = fork_length < 20 | fork_length > 200) |>
  group_by(stream, site, run_year) |>
  summarise(
    n_evaluated  = n(),
    n_records    = sum(implausible),
    min_fl       = suppressWarnings(min(fork_length[implausible], na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_fl       = suppressWarnings(max(fork_length[implausible], na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups      = "drop"
  )

fl_impl_check <- fl_impl_all |> filter(n_records > 0)

new_fl_impl <- log_issues(
  fl_impl_check |>
    mutate(
      data_type   = "rst",
      issue_type  = "implausible_value",
      field       = "fork_length",
      severity    = "critical",
      alert_level = "warning",
      description = glue("{n_records} record(s) with fork_length <20mm or >200mm in run year {run_year} at {site} ({stream}). Range of flagged values: [{min_fl}, {max_fl}]mm")
    )
)

Check 3a (error): Catch — Extreme Annual Totals

Flag run_years where total catch at a site exceeds 4× the site’s historical median, or falls below 0.25× the median (a collapse can be as much a data problem as a spike). Requires at least 5 years of history. A parallel check re-runs the high-extreme test on efficiency-expanded abundance rather than raw catch, since a “high” raw-catch year can simply reflect a year with unusually low trap efficiency. A fourth check looks at weekly (not annual) extremes. None of these are necessarily errors — they always warrant review.

Code 
annual_catch <- rst_catch |>
  filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(count)) |>
  mutate(run_year = as_run_year(date)) |>
  group_by(stream, site, run_year) |>
  summarise(total_catch = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

site_stats <- annual_catch |>
  group_by(stream, site) |>
  summarise(
    n_years      = n(),
    median_catch = median(total_catch),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_years >= 5, median_catch > 0)

annual_catch_eval <- annual_catch |> inner_join(site_stats, by = c("stream", "site"))

catch_extreme <- annual_catch_eval |>
  filter(total_catch > 4 * median_catch)

new_catch_extreme <- log_issues(
  catch_extreme |>
    mutate(
      n_records   = 1L,
      data_type   = "rst",
      issue_type  = "extreme_value",
      field       = "count",
      severity    = "minor",
      alert_level = "error",
      description = glue("Total catch of {total_catch} in run year {run_year} at {site} ({stream}) is {round(total_catch / median_catch, 1)}x the site median ({median_catch})")
    )
)

Check 3b (Warning) Check Weekly Extreme Values

Flags individual weeks (rather than annual totals) where catch is unusually high relative to that site’s own weekly distribution. We use the same metric 4X medium weekly catch. This check catches weeks with a single anomalous spike that might get averaged out of an annual total.

Code 
weekly_catch_stats <- weekly_juvenile_abundance_catch_data |>
  filter(!is.na(count)) |>
  group_by(stream, site) |>
  mutate(
    median_weekly_count = median(count, na.rm = TRUE), 
    mediumX4 = median_weekly_count * 4
  ) |>
  ungroup() 

weekly_extreme_all <- weekly_catch_stats |>
  group_by(stream, site, run_year) |>
  summarise(
    n_evaluated = n(),
    n_failed    = sum(count > mediumX4),
    max_count   = max(count),
    greater_than_four_x_medium = first(mediumX4),
    .groups     = "drop"
  )

weekly_extreme <- weekly_extreme_all |> filter(n_failed > 0)

new_weekly_extreme <- log_issues(
  weekly_extreme |>
    mutate(
      n_records   = n_failed,
      data_type   = "rst",
      issue_type  = "extreme_value",
      field       = "count_weekly",
      severity    = "minor",
      alert_level = "warning",
      description = glue("{n_failed} week(s) with catch above 4X medium ({round(greater_than_four_x_medium)}) in run year {run_year} at {site} ({stream}). Max weekly catch: {max_count}")
    )
)

Check 4 (error): Season Coverage — Low Sampling Effort

Flag all stream/site/run_years with fewer than 3 weeks sampled in the BTSPAS window (weeks 45–53 and 1–22), including those already in years_to_exclude_rst_data. The description notes exclusion status.

Note - These years are removed from the modeling dataset but the purpose of this check is to talk to the data collectors to ensure we are not missing data and the low sampling effort is accurate and the automatic fix to remove is correct.

Code 
weeks_in_window <- weekly_juvenile_abundance_catch_data |>
  filter(week %in% c(45:53, 1:22), !is.na(count)) |>
  group_by(stream, site, run_year) |>
  summarise(weeks_sampled = n_distinct(week), .groups = "drop")

excluded_lookup <- rst_model_years |>
  filter(exclude == TRUE) |> 
  distinct(stream, site, run_year) |>
  mutate(already_excluded = TRUE)

low_effort <- weeks_in_window |>
  filter(weeks_sampled < 3) |>
  left_join(excluded_lookup, by = c("stream", "site", "run_year")) |>
  mutate(already_excluded = replace_na(already_excluded, FALSE)) |> 
  filter(already_excluded == FALSE)

new_low_effort <- log_issues(
  low_effort |>
    mutate(
      n_records   = weeks_sampled,
      data_type   = "rst",
      issue_type  = "low_sampling_effort",
      field       = "weeks_sampled",
      severity    = "moderate",
      alert_level = "error",
      description = glue("Only {weeks_sampled} week(s) sampled in BTSPAS window for run year {run_year} at {site} ({stream}). Already excluded from modeling: {already_excluded}")
    )
)
